classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

assumptions: Target chain is A unless params.target_chain is overridden at runtime.
No hotspot residues are specified; BindCraft will select surface-exposed interface patches automatically.
Binder length is fixed at 60 residues (BindCraft default); adjust if the target interface geometry requires a different range.
filter_mode=permissive is used to maximise yield for a minimal 2-design run; switch to 'default' for stricter pass/fail thresholds.
num_recycles=1 keeps BindCraft trajectory cost low; increase to 3 for higher structural confidence in production.
Boltz-2 runs without MSA (use_msa=false) for speed; enabling MSA improves pLDDT and affinity confidence at additional runtime cost.
params.target_sequence must match the amino-acid content of params.target_chain in the supplied PDB so Boltz-2 models the correct complex.
Ranking aggregates BindCraft design objects, per-design sequence liabilities, and Boltz-2 per-residue pLDDT profiles as scoring signals.
plan.goal: Design 2 compact binder candidates against a user-supplied target PDB using BindCraft, evaluate each with sequence-level QC and Boltz-2 structure/affinity prediction, and return a ranked top-2 shortlist.
missing_inputs: target_pdb: absolute path to the target structure (.pdb) file — required by BindCraft and not yet supplied
target_sequence: amino-acid sequence of the target chain — required by Boltz-2 to model the protein-binder complex; can be extracted from the target PDB if not available separately

success_criteria.designs_generated: BindCraft returns at least 1 passing design from num_designs=2
success_criteria.sequence_qc: sequence_analysis liabilities computed for every returned design via foreach
success_criteria.affinity_scored: Boltz-2 plddt_per_residue and affinity_pred_value available for every design
success_criteria.ranked_output: rank_designs produces ranked_tsv and ranked_json with top_k=2 entries
